svg.title: ProjectCerebro EEG preprocessing pipeline
svg.desc: Two-stage preprocessing pipeline from raw EEG files to Delta Lake epochs.
svg.text: Stage 1 — ICA artifact cleaning (MNE · per subject · sequential)
PhysioNet: ICLabel auto-classification → remove eye, muscle, noise components
BCI IV-2a: EOG regression (ocular) → ICLabel (muscle + other artifacts)
ICA requires continuous signal — cannot run on 4-second epochs
Output at native rate: 160 Hz · 250 Hz · 512 Hz — resampling deferred to Stage 2
Stage 2 — Spark preprocessing (local[*] · 8 cores · one task per subject per run)
FZ C3 CZ C4 PZ · all datasets
Output: (5, 512) per epoch · 4 seconds at 128 Hz · left=0 · right=1 · rest=2
Euclidean alignment and z-score deferred — fitted on train split only to prevent data leakage
36,586 epochs · 162 subjects · 3 datasets · ACID · time travel
3 hardware platforms · BCI2000 · g.tec · BrainAmp · common 5-channel schema
Ready for transfer learning and few-shot subject adaptation
